title_patterns_that_work: Include explicit proof hooks like '(Proof Inside)' or 'I Checked the Data'
Target consumer apps and shopping platforms (Zocdoc, WeWard, Cashify, DHgate)
Use high-urgency keywords addressing legitimacy and safety ('Scam', 'Trust', 'Legit')
title_patterns_to_avoid: Generic brand investigation titles without a strong consumer pain point
Overly long or dry analytical phrases in long-form titles that fail to trigger curiosity
Titles missing clear categorization or high-intent search terms
notes: Short-form videos overwhelmingly outperform long-form content across all topics, with verified apps and scam-check queries (e.g., Cashify, WeWard, Zocdoc) generating the highest view counts. Long-form videos struggle significantly to break baseline median views, suggesting a strong audience preference for quick, punchy verdict-driven content over deep dives.
